messages:
Ava: Canary roll to 5% (eu5) started. Monitoring for 10m quiet window per plan.
Jon: Watching latency + error budget. Will call stop if p95 > 3x baseline.
ops-bot: ALERT: p95 spike detected on canary in eu5: 100ms -> 480ms at T+4m. 5xx unchanged.
Priya: I'm seeing one host (eu5-host-21) with high iowait and repeated connection resets.
Ava: Let's avoid full rollback. Option: apply routing override to exclude host-21 and extend hold 20m. Agree?
Jon: Agreed. Less disruptive. If override fails, we'll rollback to v2026-03-30.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: route-override apply --selector canary:v2026-03-31 --exclude-hosts eu5-host-21 --until 4923465000 --reason "noisy-host"
ops-bot: INFO: routing job rchg-9991 started
ops-bot: INFO: routing job rchg-9991 completed: 3/3 instances updated
Jon: p95 back near baseline ~120ms. KV evictions dropping. No 5xx spike.
Ava: Extend observation 20m and annotate release notes: "Extended canary hold due to transient host IO; routing override applied."
Priya: Filing INC-7520 to reprovision eu5-host-21.
Ava: Resume slow ramp after quiet window. No rollback needed. Closing unless we see regressions. :thumbsup:
